source_english: The Fighters Guild is a good place to go if you need weapons training.
translation_korean: 무기에 대한 훈련이 필요하다면 파이터 길드는 좋은 곳이지.

source_english: I wanted to get a little practice in with my sword, so I headed to the Fighters Guild. Turns out you have to be a member to train there.
translation_korean: 나는 약간의 검술훈련이 필요했고, 그래서 난 파이터 길드로 향했지. 여하튼, 훈련을 받으려면 길드에 가입해야 하네.

source_english: I'd like to learn more about spellcasting. Might have to head over to the Mages Guild and see if they're accepting new members.
translation_korean: 난 마법을 쓰는 것에 대해 더 배우고 싶었어. 메이지 길드로 가서 그들이 새 회원을 받고 있는지 봐봐.

source_english: I've heard they have good magic trainers over at the Mages Guild.
translation_korean: 메이지 길드에 좋은 마법 교관들이 있다고 들었어요.

source_english: That Rimalus Bruiant sure loves his dogs. A little too much, if you ask me.
translation_korean: Rimalus Bruiant 는 정말로 개들을 좋아해여. 덧붙여서 말하면, 좀 심하다 싶을 정도로 말이죠.

source_english: I saw Rimalus Bruiant walking his dogs today. And yesterday. And the day before. I swear that's all he does.
translation_korean: Rimalus Bruiant 가 오늘 그의 개들과 함께 걷는 것을 보았어요. 그리고 어제도요. 그 전날에도 말이죠. 틀림없이 그게 그의 전부일거에요.

source_english: Eugal Belette is an odd one... and I swear I heard strange noises coming from his basement not long ago.
translation_korean: Eugal Belette는 별난 사람이지요. 그리고 얼마 전에 그의 집 지하실에서 이상한 소리가 나는 것을 틀림없이 들었어요.

source_english: I'm not so sure about that Eugal Belette. An odd fellow, and people have said there are strange noises coming from his house at all hours.
translation_korean: Eugal Belette에 대해서는 그리 잘 알지 못해요. 별난 사람이고, 또 사람들은 그의 집에서 항상 들려오는 이상한 소리에 대해 이야기하곤 하지요

source_english: I read one of Casta Scribonia's books not long ago. Terrible stuff, if you ask me. But, some folks seem to like it.
translation_korean: Casta Scribonia의 책 중 하나를 얼마전에 읽었어요. 덧붙여 말하자면 끔찍했어요. 하지만, 어떤 부류는 좋아할수도 있겠지요.

source_english: Casta Scribonia has finished a new book. Nothing that interests me, though.
translation_korean: Casta Scribonia는 새 책을 마무리 지었어요. 나한테 흥미로운건 없지만요.

source_english: I don't understand what Glistel is doing with Malintus Ancrus. I mean, have you seen her? And have you seen him? I just don't get it.
translation_korean: Glistel은 Malintus Ancrus와 뭔가를 저지르려 하고 있는 것 같습니다. 그녀와 그를 봤습니까? 왠지 신경쓰이네요.

source_english: I'm sure you've heard that Glistel and Malintus Ancrus are living together. Simply shameful.
translation_korean: 들어봤을테지만, Glistel과 Malintus Ancrus가 동거중입니다. 유감스러울 뿐이네요.

source_english: I can't believe that Glistel would live with that Malintus Ancrus. Shameful, and her being such a lovely girl.
translation_korean: Glistel이 Malintus Ancrus와 동거하다니 믿을 수 없습니다. 유감이네요. 그렇게 귀여운 소녀가.

source_english: I think Rena Bruiant may actually love dogs more than her husband. Strange couple, those two.
translation_korean: Rena Bruiant는 남편보다 개를 더 사랑하는것 같아요. 둘은 이상한 부부죠.

source_english: I saw Rena Bruiant talking to her dogs the other day. I think she thinks they understand her.
translation_korean: 일전에 Rena Bruiant가 애완견에게 말을 걸고 있었어요. 개가 말을 이해하한다고 생각하나봐요.

source_english: Hard to complain about living in Chorrol. We've got everything you need.
translation_korean: 코롤에서 생활에 대해 불평하기란 힘들죠. 필요한 모든 것들이 있으니깐요.

source_english: Ah, Chorrol. Easy access to all the other cities of Cyrodiil.
translation_korean: 아, 코롤. 시로딜의 다른 도시와 왕래하기 쉽죠.

source_english: Sometimes I just go look at the Great Oak. Magnificent, don't you think?
translation_korean: 가끔 그저 Great Oak을 보기도 하죠. 웅장하다고 생각 안 해요?

source_english: You have to admit, this is a good place to live. Friendly folks, I think.
translation_korean: 여기가 살기 좋은 곳이란걸 당신도 인정하지 않을 수 없을거에요. 친절한 사람들의 터전이라고 생각해요.

source_english: You know, I think the mutton here in Chorrol is the best in all the Empire. Mmmm... that's good mutton.
translation_korean: 알겠지만, 코롤산 양고기는 전 대륙에서 가장 좋은 것 같아요. 음.... 좋은 양고기죠.

source_english: Lots of dogs in this town. Lots of sheep, too. Of course, I prefer the taste of sheep.
translation_korean: 마을엔 개도 많고 양도 많아요. 물론, 양고기를 더 좋아하죠.

source_english: Don't know why anyone would visit the other cities of Cyrodill. Chorrol has it all. And a fairly low murder rate!
translation_korean: 다른 사람들이 시로딜의 다른 도시에서 왜 사는 줄 모르겠어요. 코롤엔 모든 것들이 있어요. 그리고 범죄율도 꽤 낮죠!

source_english: I lived in the Imperial City for a while, but city life just isn't for me. I'm much happier in Chorrol.
translation_korean: 내가 얼마간 임페리얼 시티에 살았을 때, 도시생활은 나한테 안 맞았어요. 난 코롤에서 훨씬 더 행복하답니다.

source_english: I just feel safe living here in Chorrol. I mean, we have the head of the Fighters Guild right here in town!
translation_korean: 난 코롤에서 사는걸 안전하다고 느껴요. 내 말은, 우리마을에 파이터 길드의 본부가 있다는 겁니다!

source_english: Vilena Donton just hasn't been the same since her eldest son died. Still, she does a good job of running the Fighters Guild.
translation_korean: Vilena Donton은 최근에 큰 아들이 죽은 이후로는 예전 같지 않습니다. 아직은 그녀는 파이터 길드를 잘 운영해 나가고 있답니다.

source_english: It's good to know we've got such a strong Fighters Guild presence here in town.
translation_korean: 우리 마을에 파이터 길드같이 강한 길드가 있어서 다행이에요.

source_english: I understand the Fighters Guild is looking for new members. Seems a bit odd, but that's what I hear.
translation_korean: 파이터 길드가 새 길드원을 모집한다는 것을 들었어요. 좀 이상하지만, 그게 내가 들은 전부랍니다.

source_english: Don't get too many folks passing through here these days.
translation_korean: 그동안 너무 많은 사람들이 여길 지나게 하지 말아요.

source_english: I'm thinking of doing some traveling. Just to see the world a bit.
translation_korean: 여행을 좀 해볼까 생각 중입니다. 세계를 조금이라도 보고 싶군요.

translation_korean: 피나클 록(Pinnacle Rock)에서 적들은 모두 사라질 것입니다.

source_english: Brellach will be cleansed!
Pinnacle Rock is ours!
Brellach is ours!
Fall before me, scum!
translation_korean: 죽기전에 네놈만은 죽이겠다, 이 더러운 놈!

source_english: Fall before me, scum!
translation_korean: 죽기전에 네놈만은 죽이겠다, 이 더러운 놈!

source_english: I will cast you into the darkness!
Your light will shine no more.
translation_korean: 너의 빛은 더이상 빛나지 않게 될 것이다.

source_english: How dare you invade this holy place!
Die, heretic!
Get out! Get out!
Chalice... Mine! Get away!
The Felldew is ours! You can't have it!
translation_korean: 펠듀는 우리 것이다! 네놈이 가질 수 없다!

source_english: No one defeats Grommok! No one!
translation_korean: 누구도 그로목(Grommok)을 이기지 못해! 그 누구도!

source_english: You'll not get the best of me!
translation_korean: 니들 정도 처리하는데 전력을 다할 필요도 없다!

source_english: Take that you sack of rotting meat!
Die tree scum!
Cut them down!
Kill every last one of them!
What kind of nefarious sorcery is this?!
Ha! Take that!
Foul vermin!
They're everywhere! Get them! Get them!
translation_korean: 놈들이  사방에 깔렸다! 놈들을 죽여! 죽여!

source_english: We're going to die!
This is impossible!
Try not to kill it!
You'll have to get me a new one if it dies!
translation_korean: 만약 그것이 죽으면 새로운 1마리를 손에 넣어 주어요!

source_english: For Jyggalag and Order!
Down with the Madgod!
Order take you!
I serve the Lord of Order!
Madness shall be purged from this realm!
The Madgod is no match for my Lord Jyggalag!
translation_korean: Madgod 등 우리 Lord Jyggalag의 적은 아니다!

source_english: Order will rule this Realm! It is foreordained!
translation_korean: Order가 이 Realm를 지배한다! 그것이 숙명이다!

source_english: Why die for a false god?
Madness always yields to the march of Order!
Order take you!
The Greymarch is upon you, fool!
Order's purity protects me.
Strength through Order!
Hurargh!
Hurh!
Arrgh!
Hargh!
Aureals! To me!
Defend the Palace!
We must shut down the Obelisks!
Beware the Obelisks!
The Lord of Order will claim your throne!
Sheogorath has abandoned you, fool!
The Greymarch is upon you.
Order's victory is inevitable.
Bow before the might of my Lord Jyggalag!
translation_korean: 지갈랙(Jyggalag) 폐하의 의지 앞에 무릎을 꿇라!

source_english: The day of Madness is over!
You're too late, fool.
The sap of this Tree already flows with the pure essence of Order.
translation_korean: 질서의 순수한 정수는 이미 이 나무의 수액에 흐르고 있도다.

source_english: Why do you fight for the Madgod?
translation_korean: 왜 그 광기의 신을 위해 싸우는가?

source_english: Order has always proved the stronger.
You think you can stop the Greymarch?
translation_korean: 네놈이 그레이마치를 막을 수 있을 것 같나?

source_english: Where is Sheogorath now? He has abandoned you, as he did me.
translation_korean: 쉐오고라스(Sheogorath)는 어디있는데? 놈은 널 버렸어. 날 버렸듯이.

source_english: My Lord Jyggalag will never be turned aside by the likes of you, fool!
translation_korean: 지갈랙(Jyggalag) 폐하께서 너 같은 놈을 그냥 내버려 두실 것 같으냐? 어리석은 것!

source_english: Jyggalag will reward me well for your death!
translation_korean: 널 죽이면 지갈랙(Jyggalag) 폐하께서 내게 커다란 포상을 하시겠군!

source_english: I'll teach you to steal from the Countess of Leyawiin!
translation_korean: 내가 당신이 레이어윈 백작부인에게서 훔치는 법을 가르쳐주지!

source_english: Thief! I will get Hrormir's Icestaff from you, dead or alive!
translation_korean: 도둑놈! 네놈이 뒤지든 살든, 흐로미르의 냉기 지팡이는 내가 꼭 되찾겠다!

source_english: I'll teach you to steal from the Arcane University!
translation_korean: 아케인 대학에서 물건을 훔친 대가를 가르쳐주지!

source_english: My father will never be beaten by the likes of you.
translation_korean: 네 같은 놈에게 패할 아버지가 아냐.

source_english: You cannot stop Lord Dagon!
You are too late, fool!
You know nothing of my father's true power!
Lord Dagon will walk the earth again!
translation_korean: 데이건(Dagon) 군주께서 이 땅에 다시 왕림하시리라!

source_english: Nothing can stop Lord Dagon now!
translation_korean: 이제 데이건(Dagon) 군주를 막을 건 아무것도 없다!

source_english: I will present your soul to my father as a mighty gift!
Test your strength against me, mortal!
translation_korean: 너의 힘을 나를 통해 시험해보라, 인간족!

source_english: The Dawn is breaking!
The time of Cleansing is almost here!
Lord Dagon will welcome your soul in Oblivion!
translation_korean: 데이건 폐하께서 네놈의 영혼을 오블리비언에서 맞이하리라!

source_english: You are weak, like the gods you pray to!
Be glad you will not live to see the day Lord Dagon walks the earth.
translation_korean: 데이건 폐하께서 강림하심을 네놈은 볼 수 없음에 기뻐하라.

source_english: Only the Chosen will survive the Cleansing.
Not on this day!

Yaaaa!

Night Mother grant me strength!
I will bathe in your blood!
translation_korean: 나는 당신의 피 속에서 목욕을 할 것이다!

source_english: Victory will be mine!
Die, Blue Team coward!
You'll never leave this Arena alive!
translation_korean: 넌 산채로 아레나를 나갈 수 없어!

source_english: You're the best the Blue Team has to offer? Ha!
This match is mine, weakling!
Thief in the castle! Thief!
I'll take Llathasa's statue off of your cold, dead body!
translation_korean: 내가 당신의 차디찬 죽은 몸뚱이에서 Llathasa의 동상을 가져갈것이다!

source_english: Grave robber!
Intruder in the castle! Protect the Countess!
translation_korean: 성 안에 침입자가 있다! 백작 부인을 보호하라!

source_english: I will feed the mistress your blood!
An escaped prisoner! I'll separate your head from your shoulders!
Drive them back!
For Kvatch!
Make those bastards pay!
You'll never take me alive!
Die! Die! Die!

Did you think I would be your puppet?!
No-one steals from Fathis Aren!
Ancestor, guide my hands!
You killed my mother! You ruined my life! I will destroy you all!
translation_korean: 당신이 내 어머니를 죽였어! 당신은 내 인생도 망쳤어! 내가 당신의 모든 것을 파괴 할거야!

source_english: My whole life I have waited for this moment! Die!
translation_korean: 이 순간을 내 평생 내내 기다렸어! 죽어!

source_english: Huurraggh!
Grrahh!
We kill and kill and kill! All we know is death! It ends here!
translation_korean: 저희는 죽이고 죽이고 죽일 거예요! 우리가 아는 것은 죽음뿐입니다! 여기에 끝날 겁니다!

source_english: The Night Mother will fall by my hand! Her spirit will haunt my nightmares no longer!
translation_korean: 나이트 마더는 내 손으로 쓰러뜨릴 것이다! 그녀의 영혼이 나에게 더 이상 악몽으로 남지 않을 거야!

source_english: Die! All of you! Die! Agggghhh!
I'll hack you to pieces!
Ha ha ha! You move like a pregnant cow!
translation_korean: 하 하 하! 임신한 암소마냥 날뛰어라!

source_english: Oh, what's the matter? Is the baby gonna cry?
translation_korean: 오, 문제 있나? 애가 우는 거냐?

translation_korean: 먼저 널 죽이겠다. 그리고 나서 Ruslan과 Luronk를 죽일 거야. 네놈이 내게 했던 것에 대한 모든 대가를 치뤄야 할 거다.

I'll send your bloody soul straight to Sovngarde!
translation_korean: 너의 피 묻은 영혼을 Sovngarde로 보내주마!

source_english: You Elves are all the same! All flash and no fury!
translation_korean: 너희 엘프 놈들은 다 똑같지! 겉치레에 실속은 없을 뿐!

source_english: You're a traitor to your own race!
You humans are all the same! Weak and worthless!
translation_korean: 너같은 사람은은 모두 똑같다! 약한데다 쓸모도 없지!

source_english: Come... here!
Come to me, sweet flesh!
Blood! I need your blood!
Don't feel bad -- no one lives forever!
You do realize I've been holding back?
I've fought mudcrabs more fearsome than you!

translation_korean: 흠. 뭐였던지 간에, 지금 사라 졌어요.

source_english: Heh, I'd better cut down on the ale. Starting to see things, I am...
translation_korean: 헤이, 나는 에일 술을 더 줄이려고 했었는데. 그것들을 보고 있다 보니, 내가...

source_english: Damn rats, always skirting around in the shadows. Making me jumpy...
translation_korean: 빌어먹을 쥐, 항상 어두운 곳을 돌아다니지. 나를 불안하게 만들고...

source_english: Nothing to worry about, I guess. Just my eyes playing tricks on me.
translation_korean: 아무것도 걱정하실 것 같아요, 그냥 내 눈이 혼란스러울 뿐입니다.

source_english: Hmm. Strange.
Gone now. Hmm.
Must have just been rats.
Nothing there, I guess.
ServiceRefusal
When you have seen the reality of the world, spoken with the poor and the suffering, then we shall talk of training.
translation_korean: 훈련은, 세계의 현실을 보고 약한 자나 고통스러워 하는 자와 이야기하고 난 후입니다.

source_english: Not until you've proven to me you can handle yourself with a shield.
translation_korean: 당신이 방패를 제대로 다룰 수 있기 전까지는 안됩니다.

source_english: You must know your craft, and its history, before I will teach you anything.
translation_korean: 내가 너에게 뭔가를 가르치기 전에 너는 네 조각에 대해서 잘 알아 놓아야 해. 그것의 역사는 물론이고.

source_english: I'll need something in exchange for my services.
I don't think you can quite grasp the nuances of Alchemy. I'm sorry, but my training would be beyond you.
translation_korean: 나는 당신이 연금술의 미묘한 특징을 잡을 수 있을 거라 생각하지 않습니다. 미안해요. 그러나 나의 연금술레벨이 당신보다 아래입니다.

source_english: Oh, I couldn't just give away all my business secrets. They wouldn't be secrets any more, would they?
translation_korean: 내 비밀을 모두 가르쳐드릴 수는 없죠. 그렇게 되면 더 이상 비밀이 아니게 되어버리니까요.

source_english: Have you ever used a decent piece of armor in your life? I doubt it.
translation_korean: 당신이 생애에 괜찮은 갑옷 한 점이라도 사용해 보신 적이 있으신가요? 저는 의심스럽군요.

source_english: If you want training from me, you're going to have to earn it.
translation_korean: 당신이 나에게 배우길 원한다면 당신은 돈을 벌어야만 해.

source_english: If you want my help, you'll need to join up. Fighters Guild members only.
translation_korean: 만약 네가 나의 도움을 바란다면 파이트 길드맴버에 가입해야만한다.

source_english: My services are only for Fighters Guild members. Nothing personal.
translation_korean: 내 서비스는  파이터 길드맴버만을 위한것이다. 일반개인을 위한것이 아니다.

source_english: You don't really know what it's like to crack skulls. Until you do, I've got nothing to say to you.
translation_korean: 두개골을 부숴낸다는게 뭔지 당신은 모르겠죠. 당신이 그걸 해내지 못하는 한 내가 당신에게 해줄 수 있는 말은 없어요.

source_english: You've done nothing to prove yourself worthy of my time. Not a chance.
translation_korean: 당신은 당신 스스로가 내 시간을 뺏을 만큼 가치 있는 사람이라고 증명할 수 있는 그 어떤 것도 하지 않았습니다. 기회는 없습니다.

source_english: Not while Kvatch is still in danger. Once we are all safe, perhaps I will reconsider.
translation_korean: 크바치가 여전히 위험에 빠져있기 때문에 안됩니다. 아마도 우리 모두가 안전해졌을 때 다시 다시 생각해보겠습니다.

source_english: Nope, don't feel like it. Too bad for you.
translation_korean: 안돼, 나를 좋아하지마. 너에게 좋지 않을 거야.

source_english: Oh, I don't think that would be best for you. You need to get out, see the world, discover things for yourself.
translation_korean: 오, 난 그것이 당신을 위한 최선이라고 생각하지 않아요. 당신은 밖으로 나가고, 세계를 보고, 많은 것을 스스로 밝혀내야 해요.

source_english: Oh, I don't think so. As much as I enjoy helping those less fortunate than I, I just can't bring myself to do it.
translation_korean: 글쎄, 그렇지는 않은 것 같아. 나보다 못한 사람들을 도와주는 것을 즐길수록, 단지 그것을 할 마음이 안 나네요.

source_english: You are not worthy.
No, child. Not while the barriers between worlds are so weakened.
translation_korean: 안돼요, 아이여. 세계 사이의 장벽이 약해진 동안에는 안돼요.

source_english: Training? Oh, no. I don't think so.
translation_korean: 트레이닝? 오, 아니야. 나는 그렇게 생각하지 않아.

source_english: I don't help just anyone, you know.
translation_korean: 나는 어느 누구도 돕지 않을 거야.

source_english: I'm sorry, but I'm retired. Haven't worked with armor for years.
translation_korean: 미안하오, 난 이미 은퇴했소. 갑옷 같은 건 벌써 몇 년 동안이나 입지 않았다오.

source_english: I have nothing to teach the likes of you.
translation_korean: 너 같은 녀석에게 가르쳐줄 건 없어.

source_english: I have nothing to teach the likes of you.
translation_korean: 너 같은 녀석에게 가르쳐줄 건 없어.

source_english: No service for the likes of you. Take a hike.
translation_korean: 너같은 놈들에게 해줄 서비스는 없다. 꺼져버려.

source_english: I don't know what you are talking about. I don't buy or sell things.
translation_korean: 무슨 소릴 하는 건지 모르겠군. 장사따위 하고 있지도 않는데.

source_english: I only serve higher ranking Thieves Guild members. Go see Ongar in Bruma.
translation_korean: 나는 도둑 길드중에서도 더 높은 랭크의 일원과만 거래한다. 브루마에 있는 Ongar를 만나봐.

source_english: My services are reserved for more important members of the Thieves Guild. You can always use Ongar in Bruma.
translation_korean: 내 서비스는 도둑길드의 중요한 구성원에만 허락되어 있습니다. 당신은 Bruma에 있는 Ongar만 이용할 수 있습니다.

source_english: I can't help you until you advance further in the guild. You can use one of the other fences, like Ongar in Bruma.
translation_korean: 길드에서 더 승진하기 전까지는 당신을 도울 수 없군요. 다른 장물아비라면 사용할 수 있을겁니다. 브루마의 Ongar정도.

source_english: My services are not for such as you. Go peddle your paltry wares to Ongar in Bruma, or one of the other lesser fences.
translation_korean: 내 서비스는 너 같은 자를 대상으로 하지 않아. 그 하찮은 물건은 Bruma에 있는 Ongar나, 다른 하급 장물아비에게 가서 팔아봐.

source_english: Barter
I have much to offer, and I'm always on the lookout for more.
translation_korean: 좋은 거래를 안내 할 수 있어요. 그리고 한층 더 정진을 진행하고 있어요.

source_english: I might be willing to part with a few things, if the price is right.
translation_korean: 기뻐해 상품을 팔아요. 당신이 제안하는 가격이 좋다면이지만.

source_english: If you're looking to unload some goods, you've come to the right place.
translation_korean: 팔고 싶은 것이 있으므로 하면(자) 당신은 정말로 적당한 장소에 왔습니다 원.

source_english: Looking for a good book? I bet I have just what you need.
translation_korean: 좋은 책을 찾기입니까? 찾는 물건은 아마 당점에 있습니다야.

source_english: I'm sure I have something that will interest you.
If you like what you see, don't hesitate to say so.
translation_korean: 람의 물건에 흥미를 가지고 있게 되면(자) 사양말고 말씀하셔 주세요.

source_english: Armor and weapons. Maybe not pretty, but they get the job done.
translation_korean: 무기와 요로이다. 봐 줘는 자주(잘) 가 제대로 역할은 과연 주는 것들이다.

source_english: I'm sure I have something here you can use.
translation_korean: 자기를 사용할 수 있는 것을 갖추고 있겠어.

source_english: Always a good idea to protect yourself. I can help with that.
translation_korean: 방어는 언제래 제일의 책이다. 나는 그 좋은 도움을 할 수 있겠어.

source_english: I have food and drink for sale. I'm sure something will interest you.
translation_korean: 먹어 몬과 마셔 몬이 있군. 너도 마음에 들거라고 생각하군.

source_english: Hungry? Thirsty? I can help with that.
translation_korean: 배고픔이야? 목이 마르고 있어 있고? 좋은 몬 있군.

source_english: Just keep your eyes on the menu, and off of Sheer Meedish.
translation_korean: 메뉴를 보는거야. 그리고, Sheer Meedish로부터 눈을 떼어 놓아.

source_english: We may be in the Choosy Beggar, but here you can eat like a king.
translation_korean: 우리들Choosy Beggar에 있다, 그렇지만 자기는 임금님과 같이 먹고마시기할 수 있다.

source_english: I've got food and drink, if you need it. I haven't touched it much, so it should be safe. Might want to wipe it off first anyway. You never know.
translation_korean: 만약 필요하면 음식과 음료가 있어요. 거기에는 별로 손대지 않았으니까 안전할 것. 어쨌든 우선은 닦아내고 싶을지도. 뭐라고 말할 수 없어요.

source_english: Good food helps keep you healthy. For most people, anyway. Doesn't seem to work for me.
translation_korean: 맛있는 식사는 당신의 건강을 유지하는 도움이 되어요. 많은 사람에게는. 나에게는 효과가 없는 것 같지만.

source_english: Eat well, while you have your health. I'm sure I have something that would interest you.
translation_korean: 건강한 사이에 자주(잘) 먹는 것. 당신은 내가 흥미를 당기는 것 같은 무엇인가를 가지고 있다고 생각해요.

source_english: The world could come crashing down around us any day now. Never know what might save your hide, so I've got a bit of everything.
translation_korean: 세계는 당장 저희들의 주위에 무너져 올지도 몰라요. 당신이 숨는 것을 지키는데 무엇이 있을지 모르기 때문에, 여러가지 것을 모았어요.

source_english: Please, look. Buy. Something here might save you when the end comes.
translation_korean: 받아 주세요, 봐는. 사 줘. 마지막이 올 때에 여기의 무엇인가가 당신을 구할지도 몰라요.

source_english: I've been storing things for when the end comes. You might find some of it useful.
translation_korean: 나는 마지막이 올 때에 대비해 것을 저축해. 당신은 그것이 몇개인가 도움이 된다고 알지도 모르네요.

source_english: I've got the sharpest blades in the Isles. Maybe anywhere. Take a look.
translation_korean: 나는 Isles로 가장 날카로운 칼날을 취급해. 도움이 될지도 몰라요. 봐는 줘.

source_english: Need something sharp? Stabbing, cutting, that sort of thing? I can accommodate you, I assure you.
translation_korean: 무엇인가 날카로운 것이 필요할까? 찌르거나 자르거나 그러한 물건? 당신에게 딱 맞는 물건을 제공할 수 있으면(자) 보증해요.

source_english: Weapons and armor here. Especially weapons. Sharp ones.
translation_korean: 여기에는 무기와 방어용 기구가 있어요. 특히 무기. 날카로운 녀석이야.

source_english: Buy a drink and watch the fight.
By Sithis, I don't have all day! Hurry it up!
Make it quick.
I am eager to peruse your haul.
How may I help a guild brother?
You always bring in good business.
Shh! Keep it down. This isn't exactly legal.
translation_korean: 쉿! 조용히 해. 어디 가서 떠벌릴만큼 떳떳한 거래는 아니라고.

source_english: You are one hot customer!
So what's hot today?
This should be good!
Show me your stuff.
My favorite customer! Whaddrya got?
translation_korean: 아, 내 소중한 손님! 끌리는 게 있는지 좀 볼까?

source_english: You got some hot property?
You never know when you might need a good strong potion. Best to stock up now while you can!
translation_korean: 언제 어디서 강력한 포션이 필요할지도 모르죠. 지금 최고의 상품이 있습니다.

source_english: I have potions, and everything you need to make your own. What will it be?
translation_korean: 나는 포션과 제조에 필요한 모든 것을 가지고 있습니다. 뭐가 필요한가요?

source_english: Looking to lighten your load, but fill up your coin purse?
I'll buy just about anything, for the right price.
Need a bite to eat? Maybe something to wash it down with?
translation_korean: 한 입 드실래요? 아마 밑에 뭔가 씻을 만한 것이 있을 겁니다.

source_english: A little food and drink will do you some good.
Looking for some reading material? You've come to the right place.
Need a book? You've come to the right place.
I would love to put you in some of my fine garments.
translation_korean: 여기 당신에게 정말 잘 어울리것 같은 옷들이 있습니다.

source_english: Need new clothing? I have a fantastic selection.
translation_korean: 새 옷이 필요한가요? 환상적인 것이 있습니다.

source_english: Looking to buy a horse? I have some fine animals for sale.
translation_korean: 말을 구매하길 원하십니까? 괜찮은 말들이 있습니다.

source_english: Need a new mount? I have fine horses for sale here.
translation_korean: 탈 말이 필요한가요? 여기 판매중인 훌륭한 말이 있습니다.

source_english: Perhaps you need new armor? A weapon? I have a large selection of both.
translation_korean: 새로운 갑옷이나 무기가 필요하신가보죠? 둘다 많은 종류의 상품이 있습니다.

source_english: Armor, weapons, I have it all. How may I help you?
translation_korean: 갑옷, 무기, 뭐든 다 있습니다. 어떻게 도와 드릴까요?

source_english: Have a look at my wares. I'm sure there's something to suit you.
translation_korean: 제 상품 좀 둘러보세요. 당신한테 어울리는게 분명 있을 겁니다.

source_english: What can I interest you in?
Can I interest you in some of my wares?
Only quality goods for sale here. What can I interest you in?
translation_korean: 좋은 상품만 팔고 있습니다. 마음에 드시는 것이 있으신가요?

source_english: I offer the finest goods and lowest prices in all Cyrodiil.
translation_korean: 저는 Cyrodiil에서 최저가에 최고의 상품을 제공합니다.

source_english: May I interest you in some of my fine wares?
Let's do business.
Have a look around. You won't find better prices in all Tamriel.
translation_korean: 주위를 보세요. 당신은 Tamriel에 이보다 더 좋은 가격을 찾을 수 없을 것입니다.

source_english: BarterFail
You're going to have to do better than that.
translation_korean: 좀 더 좋은 조건을 제안해주실 수 있겠습니까.

source_english: I like you, but not that much.
translation_korean: 당신의 일은 좋아합니다. 그렇지만 너무 좋아라고 하는 것도 아닙니다.

source_english: I can't accept that offer.
I'm not giving up anything for that offer.
No way. I'm not taking that.
Try again. That's not good enough.
translation_korean: 한번 더 해 줘. 그래서 충분하다고는 말할 수  없어요.

source_english: That offer's not good enough.
Are you trying to take advantage of me? I'm not making that deal.
translation_korean: 자기, 나를 음식으로 하자고 의 것인지? 받아들여지지 않지.

source_english: I'm cursed with ugliness, not stupidity.
translation_korean: 나는 어리석음은 아니고 추악함에 괴롭힘을 당하고 있는인.

source_english: No, I don't think so. Try again.
translation_korean: 그것은 무리한 상담이다. 한번 더 시험해.

source_english: Your offer is unacceptable.
I'm in this to make money, not lose it.
translation_korean: 장사야, 이것은. 전을 버리는 것 같은 일은 하고 싶게.

source_english: Are you trying to ruin me? That offer's no good.
Not for that price. Try again.
translation_korean: 그 가격에는 안 됩니다. 다시 얘기하세요.

source_english: I'm ill, not stupid. That's a bad deal.
translation_korean: 나는 병이지만 어리석지 않아요. 그것은 심한 거래야.

source_english: You'll need to make a better offer.
translation_korean: 당신은 좀 더 좋은 제의(신청)을 할 필요가 있어요.

source_english: I can't part with anything for that price.
translation_korean: 그 가격은 아무것도 처분할 수 없어요.

source_english: You'll have to do better than that.
No deal.
Ha! You've got to be kidding me.
What do you take me for?
You've priced yourself out of a deal. Care to make a counter-offer?
translation_korean: 예상밖의 가격이군요. 좀 제대로된 제안을 해보세요.

source_english: Don't try to cheat me you misbegotten whelp!
I don't think so. You wouldn't try to cheat an old pro, would you?
translation_korean: 난 그렇게 생각하지 않습니다. 정말 전문가를 속이고 싶은 건 아니겠지, 그렇죠?

source_english: No deal. Better I should steal it myself.
I can't make that deal. Even for you.
translation_korean: 당신일지라도 그런 거래는 할 수 없습니다.

source_english: I can't make that deal.
No deal.
Make me a better offer.
That's just not reasonable.
You need to make a better offer.
I can't afford to do that.
You're trying to drive me out of business.
You've got to be kidding.
I can't do that.
You don't expect me to make that deal, do you?
Repair
I can make just about anything look good-as-new.
I'm very good at sharpening blades, but I can do all sorts of repair work.
translation_korean: 칼날을 가는 것은 매우 자신있어요, 거기에 모든 것을 수리할 수 있어요.

source_english: I stand by all my repair work. I test the blades personally.
translation_korean: 나는 언제라도 수리할 수 있도록(듯이) 준비해. 개인적으로 칼날의 음미도 해.

source_english: If it's broken, I can fix it.
translation_korean: 만약 부서지면, 내가 고칠 수 있습니다.

source_english: Not smart to carry around broken equipment.
translation_korean: 현명하다면 부서진 장비를 가지고 다니진 않겠지요.

source_english: I can repair almost anything.
translation_korean: 나는 거의 모든 것을 복구할 수 있습니다.

source_english: I'm pretty handy. What needs to be fixed?
translation_korean: 나는 제법 능숙하다고요. 뭐 고칠게 있습니까?

source_english: I can fix whatever you break.
Can't go into battle with broken equipment.
translation_korean: 부서진 장비를 가지고 전장에 갈 순 없습니다.

source_english: Let me take a look at what you've got.
If I can't fix it, it ain't broke.
translation_korean: 내가 고칠 수 없다면, 그건 부서지지 않은겁니다.

source_english: For the right price, I can make anything good-as-new.
translation_korean: 가격만 맞는다면, 어떤 것이라도 새것처럼 만들수 있습니다.

source_english: Let's see what we've got here.
Travel
Training
Let's see if we can't teach you a thing or two.
translation_korean: 한 수 가르쳐줄 수 있는지 봅시다.

source_english: I'm willing to teach, if you're willing to learn.
translation_korean: 만약 배우고 싶은 생각이 있다면, 가르쳐 드리죠.

source_english: There's much I can show you.
translation_korean: 당신에게 보여줄 수 있는게 많이 있습니다.

source_english: Let's get to training.
You've got a lot to learn.
I can show you some new things.
translation_korean: 새로운 것들을 몇가지 가르쳐줄 수 있습니다.

source_english: Good that you want to get better.
Pay attention, and you can learn a lot.
translation_korean: 집중하세요, 많은 것을 배울 수 있을 겁니다.

source_english: Knowledge is the key to success in any endeavor.
Knowledge is power.
BarterBuyItem
I suppose that's a good offer. Very well.
All right, but only because it's you.
That seems like a fair exchange.
That's a good deal.
I can live with that.
You won't regret that decision.
I'm sure you'll put that to good use.
For you? All right, I'll take it.
Enjoy it.
Very good.
A pleasure doing business with you.
That should satisfy you.
I hope you get some use out of that.
translation_korean: 그것이 여러 가지 도움이 될 것을 바라요.

source_english: A good bargain, that is.
A wise choice.
I hope you enjoy it. I can't seem to taste anything these days.
translation_korean: 그것을 맛봐 줘와 바라요. 나는 요즘 아무것도 맛볼 수 없어.

source_english: Thank you. The funds go toward my home remedies.
Thank you for purchasing....
An excellent choice.
I hope that serves you well.
I'm sure you'll put that to good use.
Enjoy.
You ripped me off blind. I hope you're happy with yourself.
translation_korean: 당신 나에게 바가지를 쒸웠죠. 어디 혼자 잘먹고 잘살아 보세요.

source_english: It is an honor to bargain with a thief of your reputation.
translation_korean: 명성이 자자한 도둑과 거래라니 이거 참 영광입니다.

source_english: If you need any more of those, I might be able to get some later.
translation_korean: 다른게 더 필요하면, 차후엔 제공할수도 있습니다.

source_english: See anything else you're interested in?
I accept such low prices only for guild members.
translation_korean: 난 길드 회원에 대해서만 이러한 저렴한 가격에 판매합니다.

source_english: I shouldn't sell it to ya so cheap, but I know you won't ask too many questions.
translation_korean: 댁이 그렇게 요구하지만 않았어도, 이렇게 싸게 팔지는 않았을 거에요.

source_english: A bargain at any price.
That's a good deal.
An excellent deal.
Pleasure doing business with you.
I wouldn't make that deal with just anybody.
You're a fine negotiator.
You bought that for a song.
I let that go too cheaply.
You drive a hard bargain.
A fine bargain for you.
Anything else?
BarterSellItem
That's a fair deal.
That's a good deal.
I can accept that.
Seems a fair bargain to me.
That seems fair to me.
You got a good deal there.
I can accept that.
You got a good deal there.
A fair bargain.
That seems fair to me.
You've got yourself a deal, idiot. Now I can sell it for 5 times its worth.
translation_korean: 이런 거래를 하다니, 멍청하긴. 나라면 5배는 비싸게 팔수 있을겁니다.

source_english: Why must I be such a soft touch?
Sure, why not. I might even be able to ransom it back to the original owner.
translation_korean: 그래, 그렇지 뭐. 훔친 물건이라도 받을건 받아야겠지요.

source_english: I do think I've been taken advantage of.
Deal! I can sell it for twice that price, to the right customer.
translation_korean: 좋아 거래하죠! 난 그 가격의 2배로 옆손님에게 팔 수 있지요.

source_english: I think I can move this item for ya at that price. Got anything else?
translation_korean: 그 가격이면야 거래할만 하네요. 다른것도 있나요?

source_english: That's a fair deal.
A good price for a good customer.
A fine transaction.
You got a great deal there.
That's more than I'd usually pay.
You've made a good bit of gold.
An excellent bargain.
That seems a fair price.
That's a good deal.
You drive a hard bargain.
You probably cheated me, didn't you?
BarterExit
If you have anything else to sell, I'd gladly consider an offer.
translation_korean: 무엇인가 팔고 싶은 것이 있으면 기꺼이 사므로 잘.

source_english: Thank you for your patronage.
If there's anything else you're interested in, anything at all, just let me know.
translation_korean: 무엇인가 흥미를 가지고 계신 물건이 있으시면 어떤 물건이어도 가르쳐 주세요.

source_english: If you need anything else, you know where to find me.
translation_korean: 무엇인가 갖고 싶은 것이 있으면, 자기, 어디에 오면 이이인가 알고 있는 좋은!

source_english: Your business is appreciated.
Thank you for stopping by. Stay healthy.
translation_korean: 들러 주어 고마워요. 건강해 있어 주세요.

source_english: If you need more, you know where to find me. I'm nearly always at work.
translation_korean: 만약 내가 필요하면 어디에 있을까 알고 있지. 언제나 일하고 있는 원.

source_english: If the world hasn't ended, I'll be here. Come back again.
translation_korean: 만약 세계가 끝나지 않았으면, 여기에 있습니다. 돌아와 주세요.

source_english: Have a seat.
Just take your trinkets and go!
If you're done shopping, you'd best be moving along.
Don't forget, only I can fence the most difficult items.
translation_korean: 잊지마, 나는 가장 처리하기 힘든 장물을 거래할 수 있어.

source_english: Remember, act casual, like we haven't done anything illegal.
translation_korean: 기억하세요. 불법적인 일은 전혀 무관한듯이 평소처럼 행동하세요.

source_english: Let's just keep this affair between the two of us.
translation_korean: 이일은 우리 둘만의 비밀로 해야 합니다.

source_english: Just walk away like you don't know me.
I'm glad that's done. I need a nap.
Another satisfied customer.
Come back and see me again.
Thank you for your patronage.
I appreciate your business.
Thank you. Come again.
Tell your friends about me!
A pleasure to serve you.
Thank you for your business.
BarterStolen
InfoRefusal
I'm afraid I can't tell you that.
translation_korean: 유감이지만 그걸 당신에게 말할 순 없소.

source_english: I'm not going anywhere with you. I can't trust you not to kill me.
translation_korean: 당신과 함께 아무데도 안 갈 거요. 당신이 날 죽이지 않을 거라고 믿지 못하겠소.

source_english: This maze truly has a familiar feel ... as if I've seen it in my dreams. But no dream could be this vivid, or last this long.
translation_korean: 이 당혹감은 마치 내가 꿈에서 본 것처럼 정말 친숙한 느낌인데... 하지만 꿈이라면 이렇게 선명하지도 않고 길게 이어지지도 않겠지.

source_english: I fear this place has addled your wits. This is no dream, but a waking nightmare.
translation_korean: 당신의 말 때문에 혼란스러운 이곳이 공포스러워졌어. 이건 꿈은 아니지만 악몽을 꾸고 있는 듯 해.

source_english: That's privileged information. I'm sorry.
translation_korean: 이건 특별한 사람만이 알 수 있는 정보라오. 미안하구료.

source_english: Look, I like you, but not enough to tell you that.
translation_korean: 이보시오. 당신을 좋아하지만 그것을 말할 만큼 좋아하지는 않소.

source_english: I'm sorry, but I don't feel comfortable telling you.
translation_korean: 미안하지만, 당신에게 말할 만큼 내 기분이 편안하지가 않소.

source_english: It's a matter of trust. And I don't trust you enough yet.
I don't trust you enough to talk about that.
translation_korean: 그에 대해 말할 만큼 당신을 신뢰하지는 않소.

source_english: Concerning this, I can only speak to a friend.
translation_korean: 그에 대해선, 오직 친구에게만 말해줄 수 있소.

source_english: Some words should be shared only by friends.
translation_korean: 어떤 말들은 오직 친구들끼리만 공유되어야 한다오.

source_english: When we are better friends, ask again.
translation_korean: 우리가 더 친해졌을 때 다시 물어보시오.

source_english: I ask myself... Do I like you enough to tell you about this?
translation_korean: 나 자신에게 물어보겠소... 내가 그것에 대해 말해줄 만큼 당신을 좋아할까?

source_english: If I liked you better, then I might tell you.
translation_korean: 당신을 좀 더 좋아했다면 그것을 말해주었을지도 모르지.

source_english: This is not something I would tell the likes of you.
translation_korean: 당신 같은 사람에게 말할만한 것은 아니오.

source_english: I'm not telling you that. Anything else?
translation_korean: 당신에게 그것을 말해주지 않겠소. 또 다른 용건이 있소?

source_english: Nothing I would tell to you. Get lost.
translation_korean: 당신에게 말해줄 건 아무것도 없소. 꺼지시지.

source_english: Two hundred gold? I don't think so. Not from me.
translation_korean: 200골드? 너무 비싸군요. 그만큼이나 주고 살 생각은 없소.

source_english: These trees. So perfect. Almost seems like home.
translation_korean: 이 나무들이오. 완벽해. 집과 거의 닮아 보이는군.

source_english: There's just no accounting for it. Sad, really.
translation_korean: 그것에 대한 계산은 전혀 없었소. 정말 슬프지만 말이오.

source_english: All I wanted was a hug.
I don't know. I just don't.
Who does he think he is, acting all high and mighty?
translation_korean: 누가 그 남자가 그를 항상 고결하고 용감하게 행동하는 중이라 생각하고 있다고 했소?

source_english: The indignity of it all.
If that creature visits again, I think I'll have choice words to say.
translation_korean: 만약에 그 생물체가 다시 이곳을 방문한다면, 나는 대화하기 위한 단어들을 골라야 할거라 생각하오.

source_english: First the vision. Then the conjuration. This is unsettling.
translation_korean: 첫째는 직감. 그 다음이 주문이지. 이것이 흔들림이오.

source_english: Clearly he was wrong. Yet I do think he meant well.
translation_korean: 명백히 그가 틀렸소. 여전히 나는 그가 마음에 품고 있다고 생각하오.

source_english: Such useless creatures.
I don't recall using teleportation, and yet there I was. Alone. Naked.
translation_korean: 나는 염력(teleportation)을 사용해서 소환하지 않았소. 그리고 여전히 나는 거기 있지. 혼자서 벌거벗은채.

source_english: It just stood there, holding its tail and whispering. What did it say?
translation_korean: 꼬리를 들고 속삭이면서 저기 서 있는 저것 말이오. 저게 뭐라고 말했소?

source_english: The sun and moons transform day to night, but what transforms the mind?
translation_korean: 태양과 달은 하루를 변화시키지. 그렇지만 사람의 마음은 무엇이 변화시킨단 말인가?

source_english: These Dunmer are useless.
Do I drop the sweetroll or hand it over and come back later? Dunno....
translation_korean: 내가 이 스위트롤(sweetroll)을 떨어뜨리거나 넘겨주고 다음에 다시 오는거요? 난 모르겠소...

source_english: The blue plates are nice, but the brown ones seem to last longer.
translation_korean: 저 파란색 접시들이 멋지지만 갈색접시들도 괜찮아 보이는데.

source_english: So many bottles to collect.
I shouldn't have pushed so hard.
That guy asks way too many questions.
translation_korean: 저 남자는 너무 많은 질문을 하고 있소.

source_english: What was I thinking?
Dirt, dirt, dirt, dirt, dirt. Everywhere dirt.
translation_korean: 진흙, 진흙, 진흙 진흙, 어디에나 진흙뿐이로군.

source_english: Who put that there?
Wood Elves. Why? What's the point?
translation_korean: 우드 엘프들(Wood Elves)이라. 왜? 요점이 뭐요?

source_english: Perhaps a trip back to Morrowind would do me some good.
translation_korean: 모로윈드로 되돌아 가는 여행은 아마도 나에게 좋은 일이 될 거 같소.

source_english: Talking to yourself is not a sign of mental illness. It's not.
I can't read them all. They make no sense.
translation_korean: 난 그것들을 모두 읽을 수가 없었소. 그것들이 뭘 말하는지 알아야 말이지.

source_english: I could use a guar. Hell on my boots, though.
translation_korean: 나는 구아(guar)를 사용할 수 있었소. 내 부츠에 별로 좋지는 않았지만.

source_english: There is someone watching me. I can tell.
translation_korean: 누군가가 날 주시하고 있소. 난 알고 있다오.

source_english: Stuck his tongue to his axe! Ha! Serves him right.
translation_korean: 저 자식의 혀를 저 자식의 도끼로 부러뜨려버려! 하! 맛 좀 보여주라고.

source_english: Wonder why Solstheim wasn't on the old maps... not that anyone should care.
translation_korean: 솔스타임(Solstheim)은 왜 고지도에 나와 있지 않은지 궁금한데... 아무도 그걸 신경쓰려고 하지 않소.

source_english: Snow. We need more snow. Can't have enough snow.
translation_korean: 눈이군. 더 많은 눈이 필요하네. 충분할 만큼 눈이 오지 않았소.

source_english: I haven't seen that before.
Bloody scamps. I could skin them all.
translation_korean: 블루디 스캠프(Bloody scamps). 난 그것들의 가죽을 모조리 벗길 수 있었소.

source_english: What makes this smell?
I wouldn't. Not even with yours.
translation_korean: 난 안 할거요. 적어도 당신과는 말이오.

source_english: Was that you? What did you eat?
Finally something interesting.
An oath is an oath.
So careless, these creatures.
Need to practice more.
I don't care for those elves.
translation_korean: 난 저 엘프들에게 신경을 쓰지 않소.

source_english: Work, work, work. Keeps my hands busy.
translation_korean: 일하고, 일하고 , 일하고. 내 손을 항상 바쁘게 하고 있지.

source_english: Goblins and rats. Seems like they're everywhere. I'm just waiting for the giant spiders to show up.
translation_korean: 고블린과 쥐들. 그것들은 어디에나 있는 것처럼 보이지. 난 그저 거대한 거미가 나타나기를 기다리고 있지만 말이오.

source_english: It's good to get up and move about a bit.
I think I need something to drink.
I heard him tell the joke. I understood it. It just wasn't funny.
translation_korean: 나는 그가 농담하는 것을 들었지. 난 그것을 이해했다네. 별로 재미있지는 않았지만 말이오.

source_english: All I needed was that right pauldron, and my set would have been complete.
translation_korean: 오른쪽 폴드론(pauldron)이 내가 원하는 전부였다네. 그러면 내 장비가 모두 갖춰졌을 것이오.

source_english: Thirty-six. That's pretty impressive, actually.
translation_korean: 서른 여섯. 아주 인상 깊구려. 정말로.

source_english: There's just no use to it.
Everyone is talking, but no one has anything to say.
translation_korean: 모두들 말하고 있지만 말할 사람은 아무도 없지.

source_english: I'm so hungry I could eat a Bosmer.
translation_korean: 보스머(Bosmer)를 먹을 수 있을만큼 배가 고프다네.

source_english: I'd kill for a sweetroll right now.
translation_korean: 난 지금 당장 스위트롤(sweetroll)을 해치워 버리고 싶은걸.

source_english: Brandy and comberry wine. Not a good combination.
translation_korean: 브랜디(Brandy)와 컴베리(comberry) 와인이라.. 별로 좋은 조합은 아닌데.

source_english: So many things do do. So little time.
translation_korean: 할 것이 너무 많소. 시간이 너무 없구려.

source_english: Guess I won't be visiting Kvatch.
Strange.
I don't know if I like this.
That was the strangest book I've ever read.
translation_korean: 이건 내가 읽어본 것 중에 제일 이상한 책이오.

source_english: A strong post to sharpen my claws. That's what is needed.
translation_korean: 내 손톱(claw)을 날카롭게 하기 위한 단단한 말뚝(post). 난 그것이 필요하오.

source_english: Much to see. Much to learn.
translation_korean: 볼 것도 많고 배울 것도 많소.

source_english: Hairballs attacking me. They were everywhere. It was the strangest dream.
translation_korean: 헤어볼(Hairball)들이 날 공격했지. 그것들은 어디에나 있었단 말이야.. 제일 이상한 꿈이었소.

source_english: Sweet moon sugar.
Sweet Skooma.
Over there. That's new.
There is much to learn.
So I said. Where's the money in that?
translation_korean: 그래서 내가 말했다네. 돈은 그 안 어디에 있는 거요?

source_english: I wonder if she heard me say that?
translation_korean: 그녀가 내가 그렇게 말하는 것을 들을 것 같소?

source_english: I should probably wash up before heading home.
translation_korean: 아마도 난 집에 가기 전에 좀 씻어야 할 것 같구료.

source_english: I can't imagine eating one of those things.
translation_korean: 난 이것들 중에 하나를 먹을 거라고는 도무지 상상이 안되오.

source_english: What day is today?
I long for a Colovian Fur Helm.
translation_korean: 나는 콜로비안 털 투구(Colovian Fur Helm)를 애타게 바라고 있소.

source_english: I can't believe it. Pfft.
translation_korean: 난 그걸 믿을 수 없소. 퉷,

source_english: If I ever see that elf, he's in so much trouble.
translation_korean: 만약에 내가 그 엘프를 보았다면 그는 꽤 큰 곤경에 빠졌을 거요.

source_english: I'm sure it's around here somewhere.
translation_korean: 나는 그것이 이 주변 어딘가에 있을 거라 확신한다네.

source_english: Now where did I put that?
No. That's not it.
A new scent is here. Who can it be?
translation_korean: 여기 새로운 냄새가 나는데. 누가 냄새를 풍기고 있는 건가?

source_english: It is hidden away. Yes. No one will find it....
translation_korean: 이건 숨겨진 길이지. 아무도 이걸 찾을 수 없을 거네...

source_english: Stick the wickwheat until soft, add the marshwillow...
translation_korean: 윅위트(wickwheat)가 부드러워 질 때까지 붙여놓고, 마쉬윌로우(marshwillow)를 더해서...

source_english: Oviparous. Ovovivparous. What's the difference? We are born and we die.
translation_korean: 알에서 직접 깨어났던, 몸 안에 있는 알에서 깨어났던가에 무슨 차이점이 있단 말인가? 우리는 모두 태어나고 또 죽음을 맞이하지.

source_english: Small fork on outside, or is it inside....
translation_korean: 밖에 있는 작은 포크, 아니면 그게 안에 있다던가...

source_english: So much to remember.
So strange this place. Far from the marsh.
translation_korean: 아주 이상한 지역이지. 늪에서 멀리 떨어져 있다네.

source_english: So clumsy, all my fault.

translation_korean: [헉!] 맙소사, 당신 괜찮습니까? 신이시여, 사람이 죽었어!

source_english: May you rest in peace.
What? What's going on? By the light, this man is dead! Brothers! Sisters! There is a killer among us! Find him! Bring him to justice!
translation_korean: 무엇이야? 무엇이 일어나고 있지? 빛에 걸쳐, 이 사람은 죽어 있다! 형제들이야! 자매들이야! 우리중에 살인자가 있다! 그에게 중재가 내리지 않는 일을!

source_english: Tsk. Such terrible times we live in. Is no place safe anymore?
translation_korean: 쯧, 우린 너무 끔찍한 시절을 살고 있습니다. 더 이상 안전한 장소는 없단 말입니까?

source_english: Hmm. Body's still warm. Looks like there's a killer about.
translation_korean: 음... 몸은 아직 따뜻한데. 아무래도 살인자가 가까이 있는 것 같군.

source_english: Akatosh bless you and keep you.
You need to go now.
It's time for you to go.
Excuse me, but you have to leave now. I need to lock up.
translation_korean: 실례지만 문 잠궈야 됩니다. 나가 주시죠.

source_english: Sorry. I have things to do. You'll have to leave now.
translation_korean: 죄송하지만 할 일이 있습니다. 그만 가 주세요.

source_english: If you don't mind, I have things to do. Would you leave now, please?
translation_korean: 할 일이 좀 있어요. 괜찮으시면 좀 나가 주실래요?

source_english: I need you to leave now.
I need you to leave so I can lock up.

translation_korean: 무엇인가 리챠지 하고 싶은 것이 있다면 해 주어요.

source_english: You want to keep magic items charged at all times. The world could come crashing down at any moment, and you want to be prepared.
translation_korean: 당신은 마법의 아이템을 언제라도 요금 해 두고 싶겠지요. 언제 세계가 붕괴되어 와도 좋은 것 같게 준비해 두고 싶구나.

source_english: Ah, yes. Let's see if we can't recharge some items for you.
translation_korean: 아, 좋아요. 당신의 아이템이 리챠지 할 수 없는가 봅시다.

source_english: Always keep your magical equipment charged.
A magic item without a charge is like a sword without a blade.
translation_korean: 충전되지 않은 마법아이템은 날 없는 검과 같습니다.

source_english: I can get your magic items working again.
translation_korean: 내가 당신의 마법아이템을 다시 쓸수있게 해주겠습니다.

source_english: All your charging needs... for a very small charge.

source_english: Yes, turn me into a vampire.
Ah, most excellent! Here is what you must do. Simply go to sleep here in the Sanctuary, at any time, and I will visit you as you slumber.
translation_korean: 아, 아주 좋아! 자네가 할 일이 하나 있네. 아무 때나 그냥 여기 성역(Sanctuary)에서 하루 자면 되네. 그리고 자네가 골아 떨어졌을 때 내가 자네에게 가겠네.

source_english: I will wrap you in vampirism's dark embrace. You'll never even know I was there. But when you awaken, we will be of the same blood.
translation_korean: 나는 자네를 뱀파이어의 어두운 품에 귀의시킬 것이네. 내가 그곳에 있었다는 것조차 자네는 모를 걸세. 그러나 자네가 깨어나면, 우리는 피를 나눈 형제가 되는 거지.

source_english: Once infected with vampirism, you must wait three days and then sleep once more. Then the Dark Gift will truly take hold. Sleep now, and awake anew!
translation_korean: 뱀파이어 동화가 된 이후, 자네는 3일 동안 기다린 후 한번 더 잠들게. 그럼 어둠의 능력이 뿌리내릴 걸세. 이제 잠들게. 그리고 새롭게 깨어나게!

source_english: Most excellent! Here is what you must do. Simply go to sleep here in the Sanctuary, at any time, and I will visit you as you slumber.

translation_korean: 뱀파이어 동화가 된 이후, 자네는 3일 동안 기다린 후 한번 더 잠들게. 그럼 어둠의 능력이 뿌리내릴 걸세. 이제 잠들게. 그리고 새롭게 깨어나게!

source_english: It's just a book I found.
Vampire
I was stricken with vampirism three-hundred years ago, while on an expedition deep into the Ashlands of Vvardenfell.
translation_korean: 나는 삼백년전에 뱀파이어가 되었네. Vvanardenfell에 있는 Ashlands의 깊은 곳을 탐험하던 중이었지.

source_english: For nearly a hundred years I hunted in secret, until the Dark Brotherhood found me. Now I have a family that accepts and even values my unique gifts.
translation_korean: 그후로 나는 거의 백년동안 사냥당하는 신세였어. 다크브라더후드가 나를 발견하기 전까지는 말이지. 이제 나는 나를 받아들여주는 가족이 있네, 심지어 나의 특뱔한 능력이 가치있는 곳이기도 하지!

source_english: Perhaps in the future, when I feel you have earned the right, I will offer you a chance to become a hunter of the night.
translation_korean: 아마 언젠가, 자네가 합당한 권리를 갖게되었다고 느끼게되면, 나는 자네에게 밤의 사냥꾼이 되는 기회를 줄 수도 있다네.

source_english: From a campsite inside Sancre Tor.
Interesting. Go on.
Belette attacked me. I killed him.
translation_korean: 벨레트(Belette)가 나를 공격했소. 난 그를 죽였소.

Looks like we got them all. Good work, soldier. The miners will be able to get back to work. You should head back to Burz and find another contract.
translation_korean: 우리가 그놈들을 싹 처리한듯 하오. 수고했소. 전사여. 이제 광부들이 일을 다시 할수 있겠구려. 버즈한테 돌아가서 다른 일거리를 찾아보도록 하시오.

source_english: There are still more out there; I swear I can hear them. Be on your guard.
translation_korean: 아직도 고블린들이 조금 남아있는듯 하군. 그놈들의 소리를 분명히 들었어. 방어할 준비를 하시오!

source_english: Horrible creatures, and they've made this mine too dangerous for the workers. We're going to have to get rid of them.
translation_korean: 역겨운 짐승들. 그리고 그놈들이 이 광산에서 광부들이 일하는걸 위험하게 만들었죠. 우리는 그놈들을 이 광산에서 몰아내버려야만 해요.

source_english: Lots of them dead, just like it should be.
Only good goblin is a dead goblin. I like dead goblins.
translation_korean: 죽은 고블린만이 좋은 고블린이지. 난 죽은 고블린이 좋아.

source_english: It is good that we've taken care of them, though they smell worse dead than alive.
translation_korean: 우리가 그자식들 손봐주길 참 잘했지. 살아있을때보다 죽었을때가 더 냄새가 고약하긴 하지만 말이야.

source_english: Filthy animals. Some of my kinsmen are partial to them, but I find them reprehensible.
translation_korean: 더러운 짐승들. 내 몇몇 일족들이 그놈들을 좋아하긴 하지만, 미친놈들이지.

Light the dragonfires
To prove he is the true heir, an emperor must first light the dragonfires in the Temple of the One in the Imperial City.
translation_korean: 그가 진정한 황제의 후계자임을 증명하기 위해서는 우선 임페리얼 시티에 있는 드래곤 파이어의 신전에 불을 밝혀야 하네.

source_english: Only the true heir can light the dragonfires, and if he has the Amulet of Kings.
translation_korean: 오직 황제의 진정한 후계자만이 드래곤 파이어의 신전에 불을 밝힐 수 있지. 물론 그가 황제의 아뮬렛을 가지고 있다면 말일세.

source_english: Akatosh, the Supreme God of Time, gave the Amulet of Kings to St. Alessia, the first emperor, as a god-certain test of the true heir.
translation_korean: 시간의 최고 신이신 아카토쉬(Akatosh)께서 진정한 후계자의 징표로서 첫번째 황제이신 St. Alessia에게 황제의 아뮬렛을 내려 주셨네.

source_english: The Great God of All made a covenant with St. Alessia. So long as a true heir ruled the Empire, the Great God swore to protect the Empire.
translation_korean: 만물의 위대하신 신께서는 St. Alessia와 신성한 서약을 맺으셨지. 진정한 황제의 후계자가 제국을 통치하는한 위대한 신께서 제국을 지켜주실 거라고 말이네.

source_english: The very foundation of the Empire is the bond between god and emperor.
translation_korean: 제국의 가장 기본적인 토대는 바로 신과 황제간의 유대 관계에 있지.

source_english: That a false heir might be crowned... that the test of the Great God might have failed... My heart fails me. It is unthinkable.
translation_korean: 진정한 후계자가 아닌 다른 사람이 황제에 즉위한다는 건... 그것은 위대한 신의 시험을 통과하지 못했다는 걸 의미하네. 내 심장이 멎을 것만 같군. 생각만해도 끔찍해.

source_english: Change the subject.
Tell your story.
I was a witness.
Nod in agreement.
